Access registered scenarios, models, repositories, and datasets by name

Source: R/accessors.R
accessors.Rd

The short, name-first accessors over the project stores (see the scenario-management article). getScenario("base") resolves the name through the registry (falling back to a scan of the scenarios store), loads the thin on-disk shell, and CACHES it in the session bank .scen — a second call is free, and a scenario re-saved on disk is reloaded automatically (the cache is stamped with the folder manifest's updated field). getData() accepts names directly and uses this cache: getData(c("base", "policy"), name = "vTechOut", merge = TRUE).

getModel(), getRepository() and getDataset() are the typed companions — thin wrappers over load_model(), load_repository() and load_dataset() name resolution (uncached).

open_project(path) anchors the whole session on one project folder: the registry file, the scenarios/models/repositories/datasets store roots, and the temporary tiers for derived artifacts (reports/, levcosts/). Without it, everything resolves relative to the working directory (the option defaults).

Usage

getScenario(name, ...)

# S3 method for class 'character'
getScenario(
  name,
  registry = NULL,
  run = NULL,
  refresh = FALSE,
  verbose = FALSE,
  model = NULL,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'en_registry'
getScenario(
  name,
  scenario = NULL,
  run = NULL,
  refresh = FALSE,
  verbose = FALSE,
  ...
)

getModel(name, hash = NULL, verbose = FALSE)

getRepository(name, hash = NULL, verbose = FALSE)

getDataset(name, hash = NULL, verbose = FALSE)

open_project(path = ".", verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

name

character, the object's registered name. Scenarios accept a name only; models/repositories/datasets also accept "name@hash8".

...

passed to the dispatched accessor.

registry

an en_registry tibble to resolve against (default: load_registry()).

run

character, optional run id activated in the returned scenario via read_solution() (the cached copy keeps the default run).

refresh

logical, reload from disk even when the cached copy is current.

verbose

logical.

model

character, the model a scenario belongs to. A scenario's name is a label and may be shared — a 48-country pass can save every scenario as "BY25A_F4", distinguished only by the model — in which case the name alone is refused and this picks one. See the model column of load_registry().

scenario

character, the scenario name to fetch from a registry.

hash

character, content hash to pin a stored version.

path

character, project root directory (must exist).

Value

the requested object; open_project() returns the previous option values, invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
open_project("~/projects/mymodel")
base <- getScenario("base")
getData(c("base", "policy"), name = "vTechOut", merge = TRUE)
} # }
